children: VerifyMe declared a special cash dividend of $0.15 per share conditioned on closing its proposed merger with OpenWorld.
Board authorized a $0.15 per share special cash dividend to be paid pro-rata to common and Series B holders on an as-converted basis.
Dividend payment is conditioned on closing the previously announced merger with OpenWorld and other closing conditions.
If merger closes, dividend is expected payable October 2, 2026 to holders of record as of Sept 29, 2026.
Merger remains subject to stockholder approval and regulatory and other closing conditions; shareholders urged to review the S-4/A proxy.
